items.rationale: OpenAI is setting up an Agency Partner program, the holding-company sales layer Meta and Google use to secure recurring spend. ChatGPT ads move from test budgets toward standing media-plan line items.
items.excerpt: An Agency Partner listing shows OpenAI building the holding-company sales layer that Meta and Google use to lock in recurring spend.

items.rationale: New AI commerce feature: ChatGPT users can upload a selfie and see generated images of clothing and accessories on themselves before buying, which puts a fitting step inside the AI shopping journey.
items.excerpt: Users can take or upload a selfie to generate images and see how clothing and accessories look on them prior to purchase.

items.rationale: Usable right away: advertisers can now preview the ad text Google AI generates for AI Max Search campaigns before it serves, a direct creative-control lever.
items.excerpt: Google Ads now lets you preview the assets generated by Google AI for your Google Ads AI Max campaigns. Google added these details to the About text customization in Search campaigns help page under a new section named "Text customization asset previews."

items.rationale: Pinterest's new Beauty Guides use an LLM plus visual understanding to turn hair and nail Pins into personalized guides with similar looks and relevant products. AI now pushes the platform's inspiration surface toward purchase intent.
items.excerpt: Pinterest's new Beauty Guides combine visual understanding with an LLM to turn hair and nail Pins into personalized guides with salon instructions, similar looks and relevant products, part of its 'Pinterest Intelligence' push from inspiration to purchase intent.

items.rationale: AI sales automation with hard numbers: eHealth's voice AI agent 'Alice' prescreens Medicare callers during open enrollment, answers every call instantly and drives a 27% higher purchase rate than the outsourced human screeners it replaced.
items.excerpt: eHealth uses Regal's 'Alice' voice AI agent to prescreen Medicare callers during open enrollment; it answers every call instantly, scores 77% 'exceptional' satisfaction and drives a 27% higher purchase rate than the outsourced human screeners it replaced.
